subject: English
question_text: Who have progressed in science and technology and why?
guide_solution: India, Pakistan and Srilanka have progressed in science and technology because they gave emphasis on English language learning. 159 A dialogue between myself and my friend : Myself : Hi Akash, what are you so seriously reading in the newspaper? Akash : Reading about the climate change of the world. Myself : What's that? Is there anything new? Akash : Don't you know about carbon exhaustion and its impact on the world climate? Myself : I don't know. Would you explain the matter? Akash : Don't you read newspapers? Myself : I read but only sports column of the paper, nothing more. I don't read serious things. Akash : Look, as a world citizen you must know that too much of carbon in the atmosphere increases world temperature, as a result more snow will melt in the northern hemisphere, the low lying countries may go under water as the sea level will rise. Myself : What! Then is it not a fear for us and for Maldives? Akash : Yes, so in Copenhagen, world leaders met to save our planet from disaster. Myself : But the rich countries produce more carbon, don't they? Akash : Yes, so is the conference in Copenhagen. Myself : Will the rich countries do anything for us? Akash : At least they should. Myself : I think they won't. The rich countries maintain double standard, one for themselves and other for the poor countries. Akash : I think so. But let's hope they will do something. Myself : Will they? Akash : They know better. Let us hope for the best.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 113 — Kazirchar Secondary School, Barisal
